hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; r=$(command -v ruff || ls "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/ruff" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; out=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && "$r" check --quiet "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; }
